personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK with 8 Hand-Drawn warmth
personality_one_liner: A late-night coffee shop and warm intimate love letter designed to help Emzilla fall asleep peacefully.

spacing.rule: Generous cozy vertical rhythm, touch targets >= 44pt, sticky bottom CTA with safe area

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and bottom tab bar
Layer translucent coffee brown tints over warm dark backdrops
Glass modal overlays for sleep mode and surprise easter egg

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Personal greeting 'Hey, Emzilla 🤎', cozy coffee aesthetic, and quick entry into voice recordings
screens.layout: Vertical scroll with hero welcome card, quick stats/mood, primary CTA button 'Let me help you sleep ☕', and featured recording preview.

screens.name: Sleep & Voice Recordings
screens.purpose: List of voice recordings for the nights she can't sleep with playback controls and timer
screens.layout: Categorized list of audio cards with titles, descriptions, live duration, play/pause state, and progress bar.

screens.name: Sleep Mode
screens.purpose: Minimal dark immersive mode for falling asleep with timer options (15/30/60m)
screens.layout: Minimalist centered UI with breathing moon/coffee icon, active track title, large play button, and sleep timer selector.

screens.name: Personal Note
screens.purpose: A heartfelt love letter from me to Emzilla
screens.layout: Paper-like parchment card with warm typography and editable romantic note.

screens.name: Secret Birthday Easter Egg
screens.purpose: Hidden birthday surprise revealed by tapping the coffee cup 3 times
screens.layout: Full-screen celebration modal with warm glowing particles, custom birthday message, and romantic sign-off 'Okay, now go to sleep. ☕🤎'.

hero_coffee.alt: Cozy warm coffee cup with latte art

coffee_shop.alt: Late night coffee shop warm lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a fully responsive mobile app named 'Emzilla 🤎' for iOS and Android using Expo and React Native. The app is a romantic personal gift featuring a sophisticated coffee-brown and warm cream aesthetic (deep espresso, warm brown, cream). Include a personal welcome home screen with 'Hey, Emzilla 🤎', voice recording cards with audio playback placeholders and replacement instructions, a 'Surprise Me' random playback button, a dedicated immersive Sleep Mode with 15/30/60m sleep timers, an editable personal love letter note, and a secret birthday easter egg triggered by tapping the home screen coffee cup 3 times. Ensure touch targets >= 44pt, safe area compliance, and smooth animations.
